fib: ______ is an essential aspect in organising government publications because it facilitates access to important information therein.
Bibliographic control

______ is the elected head of the executive branch of government and the head of state while the legislative branch is made up of elected representatives in the Senate and House of Representative.
president

The president is the elected head of the executive branch of government and the head of state while the legislative branch is made up of elected representatives in the Senate and House of Representative.
______ is a speech to which the Government Head presents the country its financial situation, considered as the difference between the money it receives and the money it spends.
budget speech
A budget speech is a speech to which the Government Head presents the country its financial situation, considered as the difference between the money it receives and the money it spends.
______ are one of the public sector publications which are actively encouraging the reuse of their data and the information is available as pdfs and XML, so that they can be easily re-used.
Gazettes
Gazettes are one of the public sector publications which are actively encouraging the reuse of their data and the information is available as pdfs and XML, so that they can be easily re-used.
______ is a process in which library materials selected for order are verified for complete and accurate bibliographic details.
Bibliographic searching or verification
Bibliographic searching or verification is a process in which library materials selected for order are verified for complete and accurate bibliographic details.
______ refer to the processes of monitoring the physical condition of the library's materials and taking action to prevent further deterioration.
Preservation and conservation
Preservation and conservation refer to the processes of monitoring the physical condition of the library's materials and taking action to prevent further deterioration.
______ is responsible for dissemination information about government activities and policies through the radio.
FRCN
The FRCN is responsible for dissemination information about government activities and policies through the radio.
______ are a major source of acquiring government publications.
Legal deposits
Legal deposits are a major source of acquiring government publications.
______ is a government publication that details specific issues, and then points out possible courses of action in terms of policy and legislation (The Guardian, 2009).
green paper
A green paper is a government publication that details specific issues, and then points out possible courses of action in terms of policy and legislation (The Guardian, 2009).
